reviews_1s: The design is beautiful but I was under the impression I would be able to use this as any other teapot. Instead, it’s more of a decorative piece. The materials listed in the description is glass and metal, and states that because of the metal it is not microwave safe. The description fails to mention that there is plastic on the bottom, and you will melt the bottom of the teapot if you put it on the stove. You must pour boiling water into the teapot in order to steep your tea. The description is misleading, this teapot is more decorative than functional.I bought this darling cup for my daughter. She used it finally and found that her tea got trapped in parts of the cup. It has now caused her cup to mold with no way to clean it. We had to throw it away. She said, at least I have a spoon. Her attempt of comedy. Not happy obviously. No stars… but Amazon forces stars. Purely decorative cup.I purchased this as a gift. I am so glad I had it shipped to my home to wrap it first. Upon seeing the box, there was no way I was going to gift it. The printing on the box did not represent elegance, more so child like marketing. Further confirmation of a cheap gift was opening the box to see the awful packaging. This $25.00 "elegant" cup was no better than a dollar store purchase. Quality of the enameling was amateur at best. Cup is also very very small. Made in China labels were slapped on the top of the box further signifying cheap. Come on Amazon, there needs to be some kind of truth to these products. Returned it!The tea pot is absolutely gorgeous, but after less than a month the spout just fell off the teapot while I was trying to pour tea out of it.Bought this as a present for a friend. It is a lovely cup but it came without the spoon, which is why I paid over $22.99 .. I could have gotten a similar item worth the spoonful $15. I had the mug for LESS THAN A MONTH, and already the handle is coming loose (the handle is GLUED on, NOT SCREWED or WELDED on), rendering it a serious hazard, as the mug is mostly used to transport hot/boiling liquids. If this was assembled using a safe and secure way to attach the handle to the mug, it would be absolutely perfect. VERY sadly had to return.I thought I would be getting a pretty cup with bright beautiful flowers, like in the picture. Instead, I received a cup that was more copper colored than anything. The handle is an ugly copper color, the copper colored flowers are thick with whatever material was used to cover them. Same goes for the spoon and flower/handle on that. Really ugly overall. I know it's probably just a fluke from manufacturing but still disappointing nonetheless.
